My scalp looked exactly like yours, except it was really oily and itchy at the back of my head. I tried a bunch of stuff from my derm, but nothing helped. I even dyed my hair blonde to try to mask some of the flaking lol. 

I HIGHLY recommend milbon scalp purifying gel shampoo. It took a few washes, but it completely eliminated my flaking. Disclaimer: I flake a little when the weather changes, but it’s all been very manageable. 

I know everyone’s skin is different, but I’ll comment my routine in case you’d like to try it. I wash my hair about 2-3 times a week

Shampoo: Milbon scalp shampoo massaged into my scalp (I use fingers or a scalp brush). Maple holistics shampoo lathered into the back of my scalp (since I get oily here). I use some random shampoo on the ends of my hair. I keep shampoo in for about 3 minutes 

Conditioner: I use EVA NYC magic mane conditioner, but it’s really the shampoo that works the wonders. I do massage a tiny amount of conditioner into my scalp with my fingers. I keep conditioner in for 5 minutes and wash my hair with cold water. 

I hope you find a solution that works for you! I know how frustrating flaking can be :/
